title: I turned a sketch into animated character
author: Square-Yam-3772
selftext:
Tried going from a simple sketch → animated character for my prototype game.

The process works but it is still quite tedious.

Sharing the process + results in the video.

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: playable web prototype if anyone is interested: [https://chooon.itch.io/dungeon-dash-heroes](https://chooon.itch.io/dungeon-dash-heroes)

comments.author: Lextrot
comments.body:
Solid start but please fix the alignment of the frame placement so jarring.  
If you want to continue with this method, look at this, hope this of assistance.  
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bfpHce8zThw&t=1s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bfpHce8zThw&t=1s)

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
Yeah, I was manually keyframing and then I found out that AIs can't do interpolation yet (besides start frame -> end frame in video gen; not a simple "smooth out my spritesheet" pass)

A full setup like the one in the video is probably better. I have a web app that produces a similar result but it is usage based. 

I didnt know that someone already figured out a local setup. That's good to know

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I mostly use GPT with wan/Gemini for video gen (I didnt get good result with sora)

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body:
Very cool! I have a tool that turns drawings into simple prototypes + a custom gpt to turn drawings into html5 assets and as well as a simple editor! I've got almost all of it completed! 

Heres my project and the current state of it!
https://trashyio.itch.io/draw2play

+ has a free guide on how to build something similar yourself! <3
